description: We are an independent geospatial & remote sensing research duo based in Rocha, Uruguay. For "Dancing with the SARs," we are building Rocha SAR-7, an open-source multi-sensor falsification system that combines Sentinel-1/NISAR radar backscatter and InSAR phase with auxiliary optical/thermal satellites to eliminate false climate alerts over Ramsar wetlands and coastal corridors. Our core team is complete and actively developing!
summary: Rocha SAR-7 is an open-source hydro-climatic monitoring platform built to eliminate false positives in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) surface change detection. While C-band and L-band SAR sensors penetrate clouds to track ground moisture, single-sensor backscatter readings (σ⁰ in dB) often confuse smooth dry clay with open water or orbital drift. Applied to the strategic coastal-wetland transect of Rocha, Uruguay (India Muerta Ramsar Wetlands, Ruta 9 Corridor, and El Palenque Outcrop), Rocha SAR-7 introduces a 7-Layer Popperian Falsification Protocol calibrated via a consolidated granite ground-truth anchor (-10.74 dB baseline). Cross-validating radar telemetry with thermal, optical, spectral, and atmospheric sensors turns orbital data into reliable early flood and drought alerts.
details:
HOW IT WORKS & METHODOLOGY:

Rocha SAR-7 implements a 7-Layer Popperian Falsification Protocol to verify hydro-climatic anomalies and cross-examines radar backscatter and multi-spectral/thermal data across seven physical layers (Structure via Sentinel-1/NISAR, Thermal Inertia via Landsat 8/9, Hydrological Drainage via NDWI, Spectral Chemistry via Sentinel-2, Atmospheric Gas via Sentinel-5P, Multi-Regime Dynamics, and Millimetric Precision via InSAR).

GROUND-TRUTH ANCHOR INNOVATION:

Uses verified Level-1 SLC orbital telemetry to calibrate dynamic wetland measurements against stable coastal outcrops, eliminating orbital drift without expensive ground stations.

TOOLS & OPEN-SOURCE STACK:

Python (Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Folium), pre-inspected via ESA SNAP.

App: https://rocha-sar7-hydro-monitor.streamlit.app/

Code: https://github.com/fabi2540/rocha-sar7-hydro-monitor

INTENDED IMPACT:

Applies Popperian falsification to orbital remote sensing to eliminate false climate alerts over Ramsar wetlands and rural infrastructure. (Slides 2 and 7 include SI-assisted conceptual diagrams).
